name: Documents bridge
description: Records opens and saves in recents and drops files gone from disk, writes thumbnails, reads Open In targets from the routing slot, builds the Open Recent and Open In submenus, takes file drops through the kernel's drop rule with a mark saying what the drop will do that stays a moment after the release, performs them (opens and places through the app's document host, hand-offs to the app that reads the file), and drags suite items out with every pasteboard representation.
